The worlds of the [[Kirur (system)|Kirur system]], home of the [[K'kree]],  revolve around [[Gzang (star)|Gzang]], a white main sequence star both hotter and brighter then [[Sol (star)|Sol]]. 
 
== Description ([[Specifications]]) ==
The double-planet [[Kirur (world)|Kirur]]-[[Kirrixur (world)|Kirrixur]] occupies the third orbit from its primary star, [[Gzang (star)|Gzang]], and is the third planet in its star system. Aside from [[Kirur (world)|Kirur]]-[[Kirrixur (world)|Kirrixur]] itself, the [[Kirur (system)|Kirur system]] contains three gas giants, a hot greenhouse world, a hot rock, an asteroid belt, and four iceball-worlds.
